description: RailFOD23: A dataset for foreign object detection on railroad transmission lines is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Zhichao Chen et al. Artificial intelligence models are used to monitor and maintain railroad infrastructure by analyzing image data of foreign objects on power transmission lines. However, the availability of publicly accessible datasets for railroad foreign objects is limited, and the rarity of anomalies in railroad image data, combined with restricted data sharing, poses challenges for training effective foreign object detection models. Coverage: not stated; published in 2024. Formats: JSON, Image, ZIP. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 6504701482 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
